scope:
Native combat fixtures: prepared parties/enemies; real attacks, capture UI,
encounter consumption after escape, PC rescue and final loss. No injected battle
outcome or injected faint/HP loss. Saves belong to the isolated emulator only.
cases: Real first encounter escaped; next encounter refuses capture without consuming a Ball
Eligible first encounter caught through the real Ball UI, added to party and registered
Actual lethal enemy attack: PC survivor is moved to party and player reaches the healing Center
Actual lethal enemy attack with no reserve: Game Over and erased battery
Actual trainer battle loss reaches Game Over instead of the native healing callback
